extracted.intended_audience: researchers, clinicians, patients, advocates, policymakers, and funders interested in the NCI Cancer Moonshot initiative
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes the Cancer Moonshot's high-level goals and specific programmatic accomplishments intended to accelerate cancer prevention, detection, and treatment by promoting collaboration, data sharing, translational networks, technology development, and patient engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ambitious timeline goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a decade's worth of progress in cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment in five years (Cancer Moonshot launched 2016, reestablished 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funded through the 21st Century Cures Act; the initiative convened a panel of experts and used 12 broad recommendations to guide NCI's goals; demonstrates expectation of rapid, accelerated progress compared with typical multi-decade timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerate discovery, increase collaboration, and expand data sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the panel's recommendations to identify and pursue goals that accelerate discovery, increase collaboration, and expand data sharing across the cancer community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the guiding triad for project selection and program design; NCI aligned subsequent goals and supported projects/programs to advance these three aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish networks for direct patient engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Create networks that encourage people with cancer to contribute their tumor profile data and expand knowledge about which therapies work, in whom, and in which cancer types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patient-contributed tumor profiling is explicitly highlighted as a mechanism to improve understanding of treatment responses; programs should enable patient participation and data contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create immuno-oncology translational network
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an immuno-oncology translational network to create immune-based approaches for treatment and prevention of cancer in adult patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on translational work that moves immune-based concepts into clinical development for adults.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build pediatric immunotherapy discovery and development network
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a network focused on discovery and development of immunotherapies tailored to the unique challenges of childhood cancers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should address pediatric-specific barriers to immunotherapy development and foster collaborative discovery and translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify and overcome mechanisms of therapy resistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop ways to overcome cancer's resistance to therapy through studies identifying mechanisms that cause cancer cells to become resistant to previously effective treatments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should include mechanistic studies and strategies to reverse or circumvent resistance to improve durable responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construct a national cancer data ecosystem (NCI Cancer Research Data Commons)
rubrics_metrics.description: Build a data ecosystem to enable researchers, clinicians, and patients to contribute data and facilitate more efficient data analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes interoperable data platforms, contributor access, and tools that accelerate analysis and reuse of shared datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intensify research on leading causes of childhood cancers
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus research on major drivers of pediatric cancer (e.g., fusion oncoproteins) and use new preclinical models to develop inhibitors targeting those drivers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports deep biological investigation and development of models and targeted inhibitors specific to pediatric cancer biology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize debilitating treatment side effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce cancer treatment's debilitating side effects by accelerating development of guidelines for routine monitoring and management of patient-reported symptoms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages creation and dissemination of symptom-monitoring protocols and management guidelines based on patient-reported outcomes to improve quality of life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target prevention and early detection of hereditary cancers
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve current methods and develop new strategies for prevention and early detection of cancer in high-risk (hereditary) individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should emphasize identification of hereditary risk, improved screening strategies, and preventive interventions tailored to high-risk populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand use of proven cancer prevention and early detection strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase uptake of evidence-based prevention and early detection interventions across all populations to reduce cancer risk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on dissemination, implementation, and equity to ensure proven strategies reach diverse and underserved populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage retrospective analyses of clinical trial data and biospecimens
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct retrospective analysis of patient data and biospecimens from past clinical trials to predict future patient outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages reuse of existing trial datasets and specimens for predictive modeling and hypothesis generation to inform future trials and care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build the Human Tumor Atlas Network
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the genetic lesions and cellular interactions of individual tumors as they evolve from precancerous lesions to advanced cancer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports integrative mapping efforts that combine molecular, cellular, and spatial data to understand tumor evolution and heterogeneity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop enabling cancer technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Create new technologies to characterize tumors and test therapies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes technological innovation (assays, platforms, analytic tools) that improves tumor characterization and accelerates therapeutic testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Cancer Screening Research Network and Vanguard Study for multi-cancer detection (MCD) tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess feasibility of using multi-cancer detection tests in larger trials to determine whether benefits outweigh harms and whether early detection reduces deaths.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes rigorously designed feasibility studies and trials to evaluate accuracy, benefit/harm balance, and mortality impact of MCD screening.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch NCI Telehealth Research Centers of Excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether telehealth can improve cancer-related care and outcomes across the cancer control continuum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports research into telehealth delivery models, effectiveness across care stages, and implications for access and outcomes.
